compatibility: Separate compiler binding; existing operation-action-bindings/v1 remains closed and unchanged. No generator may ignore the composition or reinterpret it as input values.
scope: Named Query and Mapping value connections inside one Operation realization; no new domain meta-types, domain edges, arbitrary calls, loops or multi-Operation workflows.
identity: Exact Operation selector, named Query/Mapping selectors and argument expressions; checked binding must additionally bind the compiled graph, typed contracts, field model and action before generation.

queries.source_slot: Explicit transaction-scoped collection source. Its Entity must match the named Query source and declared Operation read coverage. No first matching resource or global repository fallback.
queries.evaluation: Execute the existing named Query over the transaction-supplied rows and exact arguments. Preserve source validation, filtering, projection, ordering, limits, collection semantics and cardinality. No identity-lookup substitution.

absence.preserve: Keep the Query result contract unchanged, including null absence and list cardinality.
absence.require-present: Only an optional Query may select this explicitly; absent result is a precommit failure, while multiple results retain QUERY_CARDINALITY. The source Query contract remains optional, not rewritten. Outcome-code binding and authoring syntax must be explicit in the checked executable integration.

mappings: Invoke the existing named Mapping exactly once with all declared arguments; retain public contract qualification, projection semantics and failure behavior. A mapped record is not factory admission or an invariant proof.
dependencies: Binding array order is not execution order. Named expression roots establish value dependencies; cycles and duplicate names reject. Initial input/read roots and type compatibility require the compiled graph/action checker. Dependency layers are not permission for concurrent provider effects.
effects: Value preparation occurs inside the transaction before declared guards and effect preparation. A value failure must not commit; rollback and cleanup outcomes follow the Operation contract. Commit uncertainty remains indeterminate. No Event publication or delivery is implied.
validation_ceiling: Decoder establishes inert closed syntax and local dependency consistency only; graph checking, typed resolution, action coverage, exact currentness, generators and native verification remain required.
